top_jobs.job: When a post gets 400,000 views and the store sees no bump, help me see which posts, products and awareness levels actually sold to strangers, so I make content for buyers, not views
top_jobs.metric: orders and new customers from organic posts per month

top_jobs.job: When it is Monday and the team has nothing ready to post, help me pick ideas from what worked for us, what works for rivals and what customers keep asking, so I stop starting from zero every week
top_jobs.metric: posts shipped per week from the plan, and share that name a product

top_jobs.job: When a post takes off and the comments fill with 'where can I buy this', help me answer fast with a working link and stock ready, and put money behind the posts that sell, so I catch buyers before the moment passes
top_jobs.metric: orders within 72 hours of a spike post

top_jobs.job: When we send free product to 40 creators and only a handful post, help me pick the right people, brief them well and reuse customer proof with rights, so I get content that sells without paying for bots
top_jobs.metric: posts delivered and orders per product sent

jobs.job: Tag every post of the last 90 days by product, pillar, format, hook and awareness level, and join each to link clicks, orders and new customers
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then every Monday

inputs.need: posts with views, reach, saves and link clicks
inputs.from: Instagram and Facebook insights via Meta Business

inputs.need: orders with UTM, link in bio and codes

steps: Pull 90 days of posts from each platform
Tag each post with product, pillar, format, hook type and awareness level
A person checks 20 tags and fixes the tag rules
Join each post to clicks, orders and new customers in the 72 hours after it
Rank posts by new customers, not views
jobs.output: a post table ranked by orders and new customers, with tags on every row

watch.metric: orders tied to organic posts

jobs.job: Split each post's views into followers and strangers, and list the 10 posts that reached strangers who then bought

inputs.need: views from followers vs non-followers per post
inputs.from: Instagram and Facebook insights via Meta Business

inputs.need: TikTok For You page share per video

steps: Pull follower and non-follower views per post
Rank posts by stranger views and by new customers
List the 10 posts that did both
Write what the 10 share: hook, product, format, length
Plan 4 posts next month that repeat the shared parts
jobs.output: a top 10 list of posts that reached and sold to strangers, with what they share
jobs.next: feeds 16-08 (turn into a series) and 16-16 (boost as ads)

watch.metric: share of views from non-followers

jobs.job: Find the one platform where our buyers come from, using 90 days of sessions, orders and new customers per platform plus a 'where did you hear about us' question

inputs.need: sessions and orders by social source
post-purchase survey with a 'where did you hear' question
hours spent per platform per week

steps: Add the survey question if it is not live and wait 2 weeks for answers
Sum sessions, orders and new customers per platform for 90 days
Add survey answers per platform next to the tracked numbers
Divide by the team's hours on each platform
Pick 1 platform to lead, and set the others to repost only
jobs.output: a platform table with orders per hour spent, and a 1 platform decision

watch.metric: orders per team hour on the lead platform

jobs.drives: team hours on the channel that sells

jobs.job: Map our organic posts and 3 rivals' posts by awareness level and fill the level where we are thin with 4 posts next month

inputs.need: awareness rubric with 5 examples per level

steps: Tag rivals' posts by awareness level with the same rubric
Show the share of posts and views per level for us and each rival
Name the thin level, most often unaware or problem aware
Filter the swipe file by that level and pick 4 ideas
Brief 4 posts for next month
jobs.output: a heat map of 5 levels by 4 brands, plus 4 briefs for the thin level

watch.metric: share of posts at unaware and problem aware

jobs.drives: new people who meet the brand

jobs.job: Set a monthly scorecard for the social manager or agency on posts shipped, stranger reach, link clicks, orders and new customers
jobs.trigger: once, then on the 1st of each month
steps: Pick 5 numbers and a target for each with the manager
Fill the card from the ledger on the 1st
Add cost per order from organic: fee divided by tracked orders
Write one line on what to change next month
Founder reads it in 2 minutes and signs keep, change or cut
jobs.output: a one page scorecard with 5 numbers, the fee per order and a keep or cut note

watch.metric: orders per month from organic

jobs.drives: judge the team on money, not likes

jobs.job: Save 20 ideas a week into the swipe file from Muse and from rivals' organic posts, each tagged with the principle behind it, the awareness level and one of our products

inputs.need: rival handles on Instagram and TikTok
tag list for principle and awareness level

steps: Pull 10 ideas from Muse for our category and 10 top posts from rivals this week
Write one line on why each worked: the principle, not the content
Tag each with awareness level, format and one of our products
Drop any idea that needs a claim we cannot prove
Pick 5 for next week's plan
jobs.output: 20 tagged ideas a week in the swipe file, 5 picked for the plan

watch.metric: posts shipped from swipe file ideas

jobs.job: Break a rival's breakout post into its parts (hook, format, pacing, angle) and write our own version in our words
jobs.trigger: when a rival post gets 5 times their usual views

inputs.need: rival posts with views vs their average
organic ideas in the idea bank

steps: Flag the post and save it to the swipe file
Write its parts: first line, first frame, length, pacing, angle
State the principle in one sentence
Write 2 scripts that use the principle with our product and our words, never their text or faces
Post one within 7 days and compare to our median
jobs.output: a principle note and 2 scripts, 1 posted within a week

watch.metric: views and link clicks vs our median

jobs.job: Turn the post that beat the rest into a series: name the format, write 6 more scripts with the same structure, and film them in one batch
jobs.trigger: when a post does 3 times our median on orders or stranger views

inputs.need: the winning post and its tags

steps: Name the format in 5 words and write its structure
Write 6 scripts with the same structure on 6 products or questions
Film all 6 in one session
Post 2 a week for 3 weeks
Read orders and stranger views per episode and keep or stop the series
jobs.output: a named series with 6 filmed episodes and a keep or stop read

watch.metric: median views and orders per episode

jobs.drives: a recipe the team can repeat

jobs.job: Take the 10 most asked questions with no post (size, care, shipping, which one) from the question coverage matrix and answer each in a short video or carousel

inputs.from: Instagram and Facebook insights via Meta Business

inputs.need: where each question is answered today

steps: Pull the matrix and sort by how often each question is asked
Pick 10 questions with no post answer
Write each answer in under 30 seconds of talk or 5 slides
A person checks each answer against the product facts
Post over 3 weeks, pin the best to the profile and mark the matrix cell filled
jobs.output: 10 answer posts live and 10 matrix cells filled

watch.metric: tickets on the 10 questions

jobs.job: Plan one shoot day to leave with 2 weeks of posts: a shot list of 14 posts across 3 pillars in one location

inputs.need: picked ideas from the swipe file

steps: Pick 14 ideas across 3 pillars and at least 2 awareness levels
Write a 1 line script and 1 line shot note for each
Order the shots by setup so the day has few changes
Film 2 takes of each opening line
Log the files in the asset library with rights
jobs.output: 14 filmed posts from one day, logged with rights

watch.metric: posts shipped per shoot day

jobs.job: Build a 2 week buffer of ready posts before any launch or peak so posting never stops
jobs.trigger: 3 weeks before each launch or peak on the calendar
steps: List the posting days from now to 2 weeks after the event
Check which slots have a filmed post and which need a script
Check stock for every product in a slot
Film or edit the gaps and schedule all posts
Keep 4 evergreen posts in reserve
jobs.output: a scheduled calendar with 2 weeks covered and 4 spares

watch.metric: days without a post

jobs.job: Test 3 formats that work without the founder on camera (team member, customer, hands-only product demo) for 3 weeks
jobs.trigger: once, when the founder is the only face that sells

inputs.need: founder on camera: yes, no and how much time
team members or customers willing to appear

steps: Pick 3 formats that do not need the founder
Make 3 posts per format
Post them over 3 weeks on the lead platform
Compare stranger views and orders with founder posts
Keep any format within 70 percent of the founder baseline
jobs.output: a format test with 1 or 2 formats kept to run without the founder

watch.metric: orders per post, non-founder vs founder

jobs.drives: content that does not depend on one person

jobs.job: Turn the 3 best Meta ads and 2 best SEO articles into native posts, and the 3 best posts into ad drafts

inputs.need: articles with the most organic orders

steps: Pick 3 ads, 2 articles and 3 posts by orders
Rewrite each ad as a post that does not look like an ad
Cut each article into a 5 slide carousel or a 30 second answer
Hand the 3 posts to the ad team as ad drafts
Track results in both places for 3 weeks
jobs.output: 5 native posts and 3 ad drafts, each linked to its source

watch.metric: orders from reworked posts vs our median

jobs.drives: more output from ideas already proven

jobs.job: Set a spike alarm: when a post passes 3 times its usual views, check stock and the link and pin a working link in the comments within 1 hour
jobs.trigger: every hour while a post is live under 72 hours

inputs.from: Instagram and Facebook insights via Meta Business

steps: Compare views per hour with the account's median
At 3 times median, alert the person on call
Check the product is in stock and the link works on a phone
Pin a comment with the link and update the bio link
If stock is short, add a waitlist and tell the team
jobs.output: an alert, a pinned working link and a stock check within 1 hour

watch.metric: orders within 72 hours of a spike post

jobs.drives: buyers caught while the post is hot

jobs.job: Sort comments and DMs into buyer questions, complaints, praise and spam, and reply to buyers within 2 hours with a link and an answer from the matrix
jobs.trigger: twice a day, and hourly on a spike

inputs.from: Instagram and Facebook insights via Meta Business

steps: Pull new comments and DMs
Sort each into buyer question, complaint, praise or spam
Reply to buyer questions first with the answer and a link
Move complaints to support within 1 hour and reply in public that we are on it
Add any new question to the matrix
jobs.output: a sorted inbox with buyer replies sent and new questions logged

watch.metric: median reply time to buyer questions

jobs.job: Boost the organic posts that sold to strangers as ads, head to head against our best studio ad

inputs.need: posts ranked by stranger reach and orders
rights for any creator or customer in the post

steps: Pick 3 posts with the most stranger orders
Check rights for everyone in them
Run them as ads from the brand handle next to the best studio ad, same budget
Read at 14 days on cost per new customer
Move winners into the main ad set and log the result
jobs.output: a live test of 3 boosted posts vs studio, with a winner at day 14

watch.metric: cost per new customer, boosted posts vs studio ad

jobs.job: Turn social reach into emails and phone numbers: add a list offer to the bio link and 1 post a week that asks for sign-ups

inputs.need: email and SMS sign-up form with source tracking

steps: Add a sign-up offer at the top of the bio link
Tag sign-ups by social source
Post 1 sign-up post a week: early access, a guide or a drop alert
Count sign-ups per post and per platform
Keep the post type that brings the most sign-ups
jobs.output: a live bio sign-up, a weekly sign-up post and a count by source

watch.metric: new email and SMS sign-ups from social

jobs.drives: buyers we can reach again for free

jobs.job: Seed 40 creators with a tracked plan: pick by audience fit, send with a short brief and a unique code, and score who posted and sold 30 days later

inputs.from: an audit tool or a manual look

steps: Pick 40 creators by fit, real engagement and audience country
Send product with a 1 page brief and a unique code
Log each send on the roster
At 30 days, score each: posted or not, views, code orders, content we can reuse
Send the next box only to those who posted and sold
jobs.output: a seeding roster with 40 rows scored at 30 days

watch.metric: share of seeded creators who posted

jobs.job: Turn the 10 best reviews and customer photos of the month into posts, with written permission
steps: Pull 5 star reviews with photos from the month
Pick 10 that match a top praised theme
Ask each customer for permission and log the answer
Make a post or carousel from each approved one
Tag the post in the ledger as customer proof
jobs.output: 10 proof posts with permission logged

watch.metric: link clicks on proof posts vs our median

jobs.job: Check every health, comparison or 'best' claim and every paid post label before it goes out

inputs.need: allowed and forbidden claims with proof

steps: Read the draft for any health, comparison or 'best' claim
Find the proof for each claim in the brain, or cut it
Check paid or gifted posts carry a clear label
Mark the post checked with the date
Log any cut claim so the team learns
jobs.output: a checked post and a log of claims cut

watch.metric: posts with an unbacked claim

jobs.drives: no strike, FTC letter or refund wave

new_enablers.name: Organic post ledger
new_enablers.what: One row per organic post on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube: product, pillar, format, hook and awareness level tags, views from followers vs strangers, saves, link clicks, and orders and new customers tied by UTM, link in bio and code.
inputs: Instagram and Facebook insights via Meta Business
store orders with UTM and codes
powers: a scorecard for the social manager
